title: Conserved quantities in a bosonic tight-binding chain with non-Hermitian quartic terms
summary: We investigate local conserved quantities in non-Hermitian bosonic lattice systems whose underlying Yang--Baxter structure remains unclear. Focusing on a one-dimensional bosonic chain with quartic interactions of creation operators, we provide a new representation of the local conserved quantities previously constructed by Sanatani and Shiraishi. Using Fourier transformation and trigonometric identities, we systematically derive these conserved quantities and show directly that they form a mutually commuting family.
